name: Cinematic atmosphere hold
looks: A near-still, painterly frame is carried by two or three thin atmosphere layers: small shapes or motes drifting at different depths, a warm colour grade, and one flare pinned to the brightest point. It feels calm but never empty, since something is always quietly moving.
build: Use a static or barely panning background layer (gradients, shapes or a generative field) with two to four sprite layers drifting at different speeds as functions of time for parallax, a coloured grade overlay with a blend mode plus a grain-and-vignette pass, and one slowly pulsing bloom sprite on the brightest point.
sound: A low pad and room tone, with no hits.
prompt: Hold on a near-still, atmospheric frame as a breath between busier shots: a calm background with small shapes or particles drifting at different depths for parallax, a warm overall grade, and a single soft glow pinned to the brightest point. Nothing cuts and nothing hits; the only motion is slow and ambient. Use it to open a film, close it, or settle the pace before a quieter beat.
source: a cinematic film ("a pelican riding a bicycle") in prompt-motion.com's gallery, studied 2026-10-07.
